SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class ProfessionalPidPackageReader

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.ProfessionalPidPackageReader
public final class ProfessionalPidPackageReader extends Object
Reopens a governed professional P&ID package through its canonical DEXPI 2.0.1 model and executable bindings.

The reader verifies every package-manifest entry before restoring the canonical P&ID and revision-bound simulation bindings. It then applies the native DEXPI 2.0.1 relationship checks and exposes the supported-subset import diagnostics without converting warnings into a successful lossless claim. The executable process itself is supplied through the caller's governed EngineeringProject; the reader does not infer fluids, inventories, tuning, fail action, safety integrity or missing process physics from drawing metadata.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team
